top.question: How do I use this prompt with my own photo?
top.answer: Attach your own clear reference photo in a tool that supports image references, then paste the complete prompt. For a group, provide the intended people and keep their identities distinct. If you also attach the PicMagic preview, label your photo as the identity reference and the preview as the style reference. The preview face should not replace yours.

top.question: What if the tool leaves out a detail?
top.answer: Edit the generated result rather than starting over: name the missing hairstyle, expression, forehead mark or accessory and where it belongs. Ask the tool to change only that feature while preserving the same person and all correct details. Use a masked edit if supported. Specific directions improve guidance, but exact identity or preview matching is not guaranteed.

top.question: Can I use my own photograph?
top.answer: Yes. Copy the complete prompt into your chosen image tool and attach your photograph. Your reference controls identity; the fictional preview supplies styling. Results can vary.

top.question: What if the tool leaves out a detail?
top.answer: Ask for a focused revision of the missing feature while keeping the rest of the image or clip unchanged. Compare identity, hands, important accessories and product details to the references; results vary by tool.

top.question: Does PicMagic generate this image for me?
top.answer: PicMagic provides the idea and ready-to-use prompt. Create your image in a compatible external tool; the preview is an AI-generated example.

top.question: How should I use a reference photo?
top.answer: Label each identity reference clearly. The supplied people determine face, age, ethnicity, skin tone and body proportions. Without references, the prompt defaults to fictional Indian/South Asian subjects; a style category does not change ethnicity.

top.question: Which details matter most for this concept?
top.answer: Use comfortable, natural body positioning. Preserve actual body shape and facial asymmetry; do not beautify by changing identity. Keep the setting, clothing and major props shown in the scene distinct and unobscured.

top.question: Will the result match this preview exactly?
top.answer: No. This AI-generated example demonstrates the treatment. Your references determine identity and product details. Compare the result with your source and use focused edits or compositing if important details drift.
